# Slot assets (MIT)

These files come from [BrandonKowalski/slot](https://github.com/BrandonKowalski/slot) at commit
`1a655b8` (2026-09-17). That is the last commit released under the MIT License (see `LICENSE`,
Copyright (c) 2026 Brandon T. Kowalski). Later commits are GPL-3.0-or-later. The author's
relicensing commit (`4061086`) states that everything up to `1a655b8` stays available under MIT.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `cart.svg`, `cart_detail.svg` | GBA cart silhouette and moulding (white = light, black = shadow) |
| `gb_cart.svg`, `gb_cart_detail.svg` | Game Boy (notched) cart |
| `gbc_cart.svg`, `gbc_cart_detail.svg` | Game Boy Color (rounded) cart |
| `insert.pcm`, `eject.pcm` | Insert/eject sounds, mono s16le 48 kHz. Insert reaches the contacts at 0.097 s, eject at 0.021 s |
| `label.ttf` | Open Sans, under the SIL OFL (`label.ttf.OFL.txt`) |

Only these files are reused. No GPL-era code or assets are copied into this project.
